summary: Riftseeker’s Sanctum is the heart of planar instability on Kuua, where Riftseekers channel elemental Discord energies to manipulate rifts, stabilize planar fractures, and conduct rituals of immense destructive potential.
history: The Sanctum was constructed by Riftseekers to serve as a planar anchor point between Discord and the elemental planes.
Elemental chambers were carved into the Sanctum to harness Flame, Frost, and Storm energies.
The Rift Heart was formed when a planar fracture expanded beyond containment.
Muramite forces attempted to seize the Sanctum but were repelled by Riftseeker guardians.
Ritual chambers were added to conduct planar stabilization rites and Discord amplification experiments.
The Outer Ring was fortified to prevent Muramite intrusion and contain planar anomalies.
